title: Form filling + signup flow
acceptance_criteria: Semantic field mapper: email, username, password, confirm-password, name, phone, terms/consent checkbox, select/dropdown
Generates valid test values respecting visible constraints (username 3-24 [a-z0-9_], password 8-128); confirm matches password; checks consent boxes
Handles multi-step forms, reads client-side validation error text and retries with adjusted values, handles modals/SPA re-renders
Against localhost:8889: discovers /register, creates a test account, result confirmed via API/UI signal; credentials stored only in gitignored seed, never printed
Unit tests for the field classifier/value generator on fixtures; pytest green
